primary_claim: Rescaling GRPO advantages into a strictly negative range (modified min-max normalization) instead of the standard bi-range group-standardized advantage yields stabler training and coherent completions, whereas the standard baseline produces incoherent/gibberish completions despite similar reward curves.

effect.value: baseline (bi-range advantage) completions degrade to gibberish over training while experiment (negative-range advantage) completions remain coherent; entropy is stabler in the experiment condition

stated_future_work: There are possibly other ways to design the reward/advantage (depending on what is in the final objective) so they don't clash.
quote: The above experiment proposes a way (modified min-max normalization for GRPO) which as hypothesized provides stabler and truer learning with the clearer signal.
